notes: Passive 70V/100V (also usable at direct 8 ohm) coaxial ceiling speaker; no AC power input — it is powered entirely via the constant-voltage audio line through its screw-terminal block. The terminal block is a 2-way input with a second pass-through pair for daisy-chaining to the next speaker in the zone; modeled here as a single bidirectional audio terminal since input and loop-out share the same screw-terminal connector type. "euroblock" is the closest connector id in the allowed list for this bare-wire screw-terminal strip (RCF and B&H both just call it "screw terminals," not a named connector standard). No bandwidth grade applies (analog constant-voltage speaker line). Power taps selectable: 12W/6W/3W/1.5W at 70V or 100V, plus direct 8-ohm connection. IP44 rated, flush-mount ceiling speaker — not rack-mountable (rackUnits omitted).

ports.name: Audio In / Loop Out
ports.note: Screw-terminal block for 70V/100V constant-voltage line (selectable 12W/6W/3W/1.5W taps) or direct 8-ohm connection; includes pass-through terminals for daisy-chaining additional speakers
